mapper.sql: a.asrs_id, a.plant_cd, a.asrs_cd, a.asrs_nm, a.store_node_id, s.node_cd as store_node_cd, a.in_node_id, i.node_cd as in_node_cd, a.out_node_id, o.node_cd as out_node_cd, a.terminal_id, t.terminal_cd, a.conn_mode, a.wes_url, a.use_yn, a.remark, a.row_ver

from wms_asrs a join mst_equip_hier s on s.node_id = a.store_node_id join mst_equip_hier i on i.node_id = a.in_node_id join mst_equip_hier o on o.node_id = a.out_node_id join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = a.terminal_id
mapper.select: select where a.asrs_id = #{id}
select where a.terminal_id = #{terminalId} and a.use_yn = 'Y' and t.revoked_at is null

insert into wms_asrs (comp_cd, plant_cd, asrs_cd, asrs_nm, store_node_id, in_node_id, out_node_id, terminal_id, conn_mode, wes_url, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.plantCd}, #{f.asrsCd}, #{f.asrsNm}, #{f.storeNodeId}, #{f.inNodeId}, #{f.outNodeId}, #{f.terminalId}, #{f.connMode}, #{f.wesUrl}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning asrs_id

select h.node_id as "nodeId", h.plant_cd as "plantCd", h.use_yn as "useYn", coalesce(a.loc_usage, 'STORAGE') as "usage" from mst_equip_hier h left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = h.node_id where h.node_id = #{nodeId}
select exists (select 1 from sys_terminal where terminal_id = #{id} and terminal_type = 'COLLECTOR' and revoked_at is null)
select type_id, type_cd, type_nm, length_mm, width_mm, height_mm, slot_cnt, use_yn, row_ver from wms_ctr_type order by type_cd
select type_id, type_cd, type_nm, length_mm, width_mm, height_mm, slot_cnt, use_yn, row_ver from wms_ctr_type where type_id = #{id}

insert into wms_ctr_type (comp_cd, type_cd, type_nm, length_mm, width_mm, height_mm, slot_cnt, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.typeCd}, #{f.typeNm}, #{f.lengthMm}, #{f.widthMm}, #{f.heightMm}, #{f.slotCnt}, #{f.useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning type_id
mapper.sql: c.ctr_id, c.asrs_id, a.asrs_cd, c.ctr_cd, c.type_id, t.type_cd, t.slot_cnt, c.status, c.exc_reason, c.use_yn, c.row_ver, exists (select 1 from wms_ctr_content x where x.ctr_id = c.ctr_id group by x.slot_no, x.item_id having count(distinct coalesce(x.lot_id, 0)) > 1) as mixed_lot, (select count(*) from wms_ctr_content x where x.ctr_id = c.ctr_id)::int as content_rows
from wms_ctr c join wms_asrs a on a.asrs_id = c.asrs_id join wms_ctr_type t on t.type_id = c.type_id
mapper.select: select where c.ctr_id = #{id}
select c.ctr_id, c.asrs_id, c.ctr_cd, c.type_id, c.status, c.exc_reason, c.use_yn, c.row_ver from wms_ctr c where c.ctr_id = #{id} for update
select c.ctr_id, c.asrs_id, c.ctr_cd, c.type_id, c.status, c.exc_reason, c.use_yn, c.row_ver from wms_ctr c where c.ctr_cd = #{ctrCd} for update
insert into wms_ctr (comp_cd, asrs_id, ctr_cd, type_id, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.asrsId}, #{f.ctrCd}, #{f.typeId}, #{f.useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning ctr_id
mapper.update: update wms_ctr set type_id = #{f.typeId}, use_yn = #{f.useYn}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ctr_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer}
update wms_ctr set status = #{status}, exc_reason = #{reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where ctr_id = #{id}
mapper.select: select x.content_id, x.ctr_id, x.slot_no, x.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, x.lot_id, l.lot_no, x.stock_status, x.qty from wms_ctr_content x join mst_item i on i.item_id = x.item_id left join lot_master l on l.lot_id = x.lot_id where x.ctr_id = #{ctrId} order by x.slot_no, i.item_cd, l.lot_no nulls first
mapper.insert: insert into wms_ctr_content (comp_cd, ctr_id, slot_no, item_id, lot_id, stock_status, qty, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{ctrId}, #{slotNo}, #{itemId}, #{lotId}, #{status}, #{qty}, #{by})
mapper.select: select item_id from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd} and use_yn = 'Y'
select lot_id from lot_master where item_id = #{itemId} and lot_no = #{lotNo}
select coalesce((select qty from inv_stock where item_id = #{itemId} and node_id = #{nodeId} and lot_id is not distinct from #{lotId}::bigint and stock_status = #{status}), 0)
insert into wms_asrs_req (comp_cd, asrs_id, req_type, req_key, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{asrsId}, #{type}, #{reqKey}, #{remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning req_id
mapper.insert: insert into wms_asrs_req_line (comp_cd, req_id, line_no, ctr_id, item_id, lot_id, qty, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{reqId}, #{lineNo}, #{ctrId}, #{itemId}, #{lotId}, #{qty}, #{by})
mapper.sql: r.req_id, r.asrs_id, a.asrs_cd, r.req_type, r.req_key, r.send_state, r.sent_at, r.created_at, r.created_by, r.remark, r.row_ver, r.urgent_yn, r.urgent_reason, g.line_cnt, g.done_cnt, case when r.send_state = 'CANCELLED' then 'CANCELLED' when g.line_cnt = 0 then 'NOT_STARTED' when g.done_cnt = g.line_cnt then 'DONE' when g.done_cnt = 0 and g.short_cnt = 0 and g.fail_cnt > 0 and g.open_cnt = 0 then 'FAILED' when g.started_cnt = 0 then 'NOT_STARTED' when g.open_cnt = 0 then 'PARTIAL' else 'IN_PROGRESS' end as progress

from wms_asrs_req r join wms_asrs a on a.asrs_id = r.asrs_id join lateral (select count(*)::int as line_cnt, count(*) filter (where l.status = 'DONE')::int as done_cnt, count(*) filter (where l.status = 'FAILED')::int as fail_cnt, count(*) filter (where l.status = 'SHORT')::int as short_cnt, count(*) filter (where l.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS'))::int as open_cnt, count(*) filter (where l.status <> 'NOT_STARTED')::int as started_cnt from wms_asrs_req_line l where l.req_id = r.req_id) g on true
mapper.select: select where r.req_id = #{id}
select r.req_id, r.asrs_id, r.req_type, r.req_key, r.send_state, r.row_ver, r.urgent_yn, r.urgent_reason from wms_asrs_req r where r.req_id = #{id} for update
mapper.sql: l.line_id, l.req_id, l.line_no, l.ctr_id, c.ctr_cd, l.item_id, i.item_cd, l.lot_id, lm.lot_no, l.qty, l.done_qty, l.status, l.wes_status, l.last_reason, l.started_at, l.finished_at
mapper.select: select from wms_asrs_req_line l left join wms_ctr c on c.ctr_id = l.ctr_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = l.lot_id where l.req_id = #{reqId} order by l.line_no

select from wms_asrs_req_line l left join wms_ctr c on c.ctr_id = l.ctr_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = l.lot_id where l.req_id = #{reqId} and l.line_no = #{lineNo} for update of l
mapper.update: update wms_asrs_req_line set status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = now(), row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where req_id = #{reqId} and status = 'NOT_STARTED'
mapper.select: select from wms_asrs_req_line l join wms_asrs_req r on r.req_id = l.req_id left join wms_ctr c on c.ctr_id = l.ctr_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = l.lot_id where l.ctr_id = #{ctrId} and r.req_type = 'IN' and r.send_state = 'SENT' and l.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS') order by l.line_id limit 1
select exists (select 1 from wms_asrs_req_line where ctr_id = #{ctrId} and status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS'))

select r.req_id from wms_asrs_req r where r.send_state = 'SENT' and r.sent_at < now() - make_interval(mins => #{minutes}) and exists (select 1 from wms_asrs_req_line l where l.req_id = r.req_id and l.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS')) and not exists (select 1 from wms_asrs_event e where e.req_id = r.req_id and e.event_cd = 'STALE_REQ') order by r.req_id limit 200 for update of r skip locked
mapper.insert: insert into wms_asrs_event (comp_cd, asrs_id, req_id, line_id, ctr_id, event_cd, wes_status, reason_cd, detail, inbound_id, move_grp_id, src, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{asrsId}, #{reqId}, #{lineId}, #{ctrId}, #{eventCd}, #{wesStatus}, #{reasonCd}, #{detail}, #{inboundId}, #{moveGrpId}, #{src}, #{occurredAt}, #{method}, #{by})
mapper.sql: e.event_id, e.req_id, e.line_id, e.ctr_id, c.ctr_cd, e.event_cd, e.wes_status, e.reason_cd, e.detail, e.src, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_by
mapper.select: select from wms_asrs_event e left join wms_ctr c on c.ctr_id = e.ctr_id where e.req_id = #{reqId} order by e.event_id limit 500
select from wms_asrs_event e left join wms_ctr c on c.ctr_id = e.ctr_id where e.ctr_id = #{ctrId} order by e.event_id desc limit 200
select exists (select 1 from sys_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and code = #{code} and use_yn = 'Y') or exists (select 1 from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and code = #{code} and use_yn = 'Y')

select coalesce((select sum(s.qty) from inv_stock s where s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.node_id = #{nodeId} and s.stock_status = 'AVAILABLE' and (#{lotId}::bigint is null or s.lot_id = #{lotId}::bigint)), 0) - coalesce((select sum(x.qty) from wms_ctr_content x join wms_ctr c on c.ctr_id = x.ctr_id where c.asrs_id = #{asrsId} and c.status = 'QUARANTINE' and x.item_id = #{itemId} and x.stock_status = 'AVAILABLE' and (#{lotId}::bigint is null or x.lot_id = #{lotId}::bigint)), 0) - coalesce((select sum(l.qty - l.done_qty) from wms_asrs_req_line l join wms_asrs_req r on r.req_id = l.req_id where r.asrs_id = #{asrsId} and r.req_type = 'OUT' and r.send_state <> 'CANCELLED' and l.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS') and l.item_id = #{itemId} and (#{lotId}::bigint is null or l.lot_id is null or l.lot_id = #{lotId}::bigint)), 0)

select x.content_id, x.ctr_id, x.slot_no, x.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, x.lot_id, l.lot_no, x.stock_status, x.qty from wms_ctr_content x join mst_item i on i.item_id = x.item_id left join lot_master l on l.lot_id = x.lot_id where x.ctr_id = #{ctrId} and x.item_id = #{itemId} and x.stock_status = 'AVAILABLE' and (#{lotId}::bigint is null or x.lot_id = #{lotId}::bigint) and (#{slot}::int is null or x.slot_no = #{slot}::int) order by x.slot_no, x.content_id for update of x
mapper.update: update wms_ctr_content set qty = #{qty}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where content_id = #{contentId}
update wms_asrs_req set urgent_yn = 'Y', urgent_reason = #{reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where req_id = #{id} and urgent_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select count(*)::int from wms_asrs_req where req_type = 'OUT' and created_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days})
select count(*)::int from wms_asrs_event where event_cd = 'URGENT' and occurred_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days})

select recorded_by as marked_by, count(*)::int as cnt from wms_asrs_event where event_cd = 'URGENT' and occurred_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) group by recorded_by order by count(*) desc, recorded_by limit 50
mapper.sql: r.recon_id, r.asrs_id, a.asrs_cd, r.snap_key, r.status, r.part_cnt, r.expected_parts, r.ctr_cnt, r.skipped_cnt, r.diff_cnt, (select count(*) from wms_asrs_recon_diff d where d.recon_id = r.recon_id and d.status = 'OPEN')::int as open_cnt, r.started_at, r.finished_at
mapper.select: insert into wms_asrs_recon (comp_cd, asrs_id, snap_key, created_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{asrsId}, #{snapKey}, #{by}) on conflict (comp_cd, asrs_id, snap_key) do nothing returning recon_id
select exists (select 1 from wms_asrs_recon_part where recon_id = #{reconId} and part_no = #{partNo})
mapper.insert: insert into wms_asrs_recon_part (comp_cd, recon_id, part_no, body) values (hb_current_comp(), #{reconId}, #{partNo}, #{body}::jsonb)
mapper.select: select body::text from wms_asrs_recon_part where recon_id = #{reconId} order by part_no
mapper.update: update wms_asrs_recon set part_cnt = (select count(*) from wms_asrs_recon_part p where p.recon_id = #{reconId}), expected_parts = coalesce(#{expected}::int, expected_parts) where recon_id = #{reconId}
update wms_asrs_recon set status = 'DONE', ctr_cnt = #{ctrCnt}, skipped_cnt = #{skipped}, diff_cnt = #{diffCnt}, finished_at = now() where recon_id = #{reconId}
mapper.select: select c.ctr_id, c.ctr_cd, x.slot_no, x.item_id, i.item_cd, x.lot_id, l.lot_no, x.stock_status, x.qty from wms_ctr c join wms_ctr_content x on x.ctr_id = c.ctr_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = x.item_id left join lot_master l on l.lot_id = x.lot_id where c.asrs_id = #{asrsId} and c.status in ('IN_SYSTEM', 'QUARANTINE') order by c.ctr_cd, x.slot_no, x.content_id
select c.ctr_id, c.asrs_id, c.ctr_cd, c.type_id, c.status, c.exc_reason, c.use_yn, c.row_ver from wms_ctr c where c.asrs_id = #{asrsId}

select l.ctr_id from wms_asrs_req_line l join wms_asrs_req r on r.req_id = l.req_id where r.asrs_id = #{asrsId} and l.ctr_id is not null and l.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS') and r.send_state <> 'DRAFT' union select e.ctr_id from wms_asrs_event e join wms_asrs_req_line l on l.line_id = e.line_id where e.asrs_id = #{asrsId} and e.ctr_id is not null and l.status in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.insert: insert into wms_asrs_recon_diff (comp_cd, recon_id, asrs_id, ctr_id, ctr_cd, slot_no, item_id, item_cd, lot_id, lot_no, stock_status, our_qty, wes_qty, diff_kind) values (hb_current_comp(), #{d.reconId}, #{d.asrsId}, #{d.ctrId}, #{d.ctrCd}, #{d.slotNo}, #{d.itemId}, #{d.itemCd}, #{d.lotId}, #{d.lotNo}, #{d.stockStatus}, #{d.ourQty}, #{d.wesQty}, #{d.diffKind})
mapper.select: select from wms_asrs_recon r join wms_asrs a on a.asrs_id = r.asrs_id where r.recon_id = #{id}
mapper.sql: d.diff_id, d.recon_id, d.asrs_id, d.ctr_id, d.ctr_cd, d.slot_no, d.item_id, d.item_cd, d.lot_id, d.lot_no, d.stock_status, d.our_qty, d.wes_qty, d.diff_kind, d.status, d.adj_req_id, d.reason_cd, d.remark, d.resolved_by, d.resolved_at, d.row_ver
mapper.select: select from wms_asrs_recon_diff d where d.recon_id = #{reconId} order by d.ctr_cd, d.slot_no, d.item_cd, d.diff_id limit 2000
select from wms_asrs_recon_diff d where d.diff_id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update wms_asrs_recon_diff set status = #{status}, adj_req_id = #{adjReqId}, reason_cd = #{reason}, remark = #{remark}, resolved_by = #{by}, resolved_at = now(), row_ver = row_ver + 1 where diff_id = #{id} and status = 'OPEN' and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select count(*)::int from wms_asrs_recon_diff where ctr_id = #{ctrId} and status = 'OPEN'
select coalesce(sum(qty), 0) from wms_ctr_content where ctr_id = #{ctrId} and slot_no = #{slot} and item_id = #{itemId} and lot_id is not distinct from #{lotId}::bigint

select x.content_id, x.ctr_id, x.slot_no, x.item_id, x.lot_id, x.stock_status, x.qty from wms_ctr_content x where x.ctr_id = #{ctrId} and x.slot_no = #{slot} and x.item_id = #{itemId} and x.lot_id is not distinct from #{lotId}::bigint and x.stock_status = #{status} for update
